description: A channel present in only ONE of the two bracketing keys blends against the part's own authored opacity, not against a schema-wide 1. 'fadeIn' is a ghost authored at 0.4 keyed to 1 at the end, so it ramps 0.4 -> 1 and its first frame is the part as authored; 'fadeOut' is keyed at the start only and decays back to its own 0.4. Blending against a constant 1 instead would make 'fadeIn' a flat 1 for the whole clip -- the part's authored translucency silently discarded by a key that never mentioned t=0.
